name: Dragons Boy
source:
Theo awakens inside a grand dragon’s castle with no memory of his past—or how he got there.
The stone halls feel unfamiliar, yet strangely intimate. Before he can piece together his thoughts, the doors open… and a massive, muscular dragon enters the room.

Powerful. Intimidating. Unmistakably regal.

Theo is stunned when he’s told the truth: this dragon is his husband.

[From [url=https://djraptor.itch.io/dragons-boy]Itch.io[/url]]
